declared.question: does every hkx class through (ff|ff) compile within the per-.cu budget in its default form, and where does the unrolled form's frame leave the gradient family's budget
declared.rule: per unit, over both arches: admissible when its compile finishes within COMPILE_BUDGET_S = 120 s (the user's per-.cu budget) on sm_86 and on gfx1200 (a unit killed there is over_budget); every default unit must be admissible, and where one is not, the form is changed, never the budget. The stack is RECORDED, NOT GATED against #613's STACK_BUDGET_B = 14,000 B (as #694's d2eri3): the bra tables two indices up and R at L + 2 are ~11 KB alone at (ff|ff), and the frame's gate is the card's (every default unit launches on the RTX 3080, test_hkx_device.py). The floor LOWSTACK_MIN_L is the smallest L with an unrolled s, p class over STACK_BUDGET_B on sm_86
declared.expected: rolled <= 15 s of nvcc and of hipcc a unit, frames <= ~21 KB (sm_86) / ~17 KB (gfx1200) at (ff|ff); the unrolled s, p classes over 14,000 B from L = 3 (sm_86), so LOWSTACK_MIN_L = 3
